subject.title: fix(mattermost): preserve text-block boundaries in draft preview (#87322)

question: Should Mattermost block mode permanently preserve text and tool phases as separate visible posts, with the additive shared callback-ordering and draft-loop seams used to maintain their chronology?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but automation cannot choose the intended visible delivery contract or permanently accept plugin-SDK-adjacent surface on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve block generations
options.body: Ship persistent per-block posts and accept the additive opt-in shared seams after exact-head gates pass.

options.title: Retain one visible sink
options.body: Require a different design that preserves block content but consolidates terminal presentation into one surviving post.

recommendation.title: Approve block generations
recommendation.body: Ship persistent per-block posts and accept the additive opt-in shared seams after exact-head gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and author of the adopted final architecture.
